accuracy_and_baseline.citation_rule: Neither 1.6667x arithmetic count nor 2.9441x local bit movement is an M163 measured speedup. No cycle, energy, physical, network, or system speedup is citable.

reasons: The actual worst setup slack 0.0002 ns fails the predeclared 0.05 ns guard.
Hold is printed as 0.0000 ns and has no useful margin.
The failed run did not produce an output evidence manifest.
Area and timing cost the semantically wrong scalar-moment design, not the required per-lane successor.
ZeroWireload and ideal clock are not post-layout PPA.

findings.evidence: The sealed mapped netlist has only scalar moment_sum[47:0], moment_sumsq[55:0], and moment_count[31:0], while the contract defines 16 hidden lanes. The directed TB used the same cross-lane scalar reference.
findings.impact: The module cannot produce no_running BN1's per-channel mean/variance; the passing VCS is self-consistent against the wrong grain, and the DC area is for the wrong design.
findings.required_fix: Maintain and emit 16 independent per-lane sum/sumsq/count states, accumulate spatial tiles into the same lane, miter unequal-lane moments, and repeat exact-SHA VCS/DC.
findings.title: Scalar moment reduction mixes 16 hidden channels

findings.evidence: The 100 setup slacks are sorted from 0.0002 to 0.0765 ns. The scratch anchor recorded 0.0765; the exact runner's first-path parser correctly failed the 0.05 ns guard with exit 41.
findings.impact: The claimed scratch margin was overstated by 0.0763 ns, and r1 has effectively no setup or hold cushion.
findings.required_fix: Parse all paths and take min slack, assert report ordering/count, preserve the 0.05 ns setup guard, and rerun the corrected design.
findings.title: Scratch timing parser selected the last, not worst, setup path

findings.evidence: Current RTL/TB/SVA hashes all differ from the sealed VCS input manifest; r1 source was untracked and not copied into the sealed run.
findings.impact: Independent exact-SHA source rerun and source-level edge-case expansion are unavailable.
findings.required_fix: Future sealed runs must copy immutable RTL/TB/SVA/filelist sources into the run or commit them before launch.
findings.title: Sealed r1 source bytes are no longer present at production paths

findings.evidence: The test uses synthetic factors and one global shift. No checkpoint-bound factor quantization, PAFT, valid825, or network miter exists; early requant changes the moments used by no_running BN.
findings.impact: Functional RTL correctness cannot establish accuracy or usable rank3 factors/scales.
findings.required_fix: Train/calibrate the exact Q8-before-moment order, export factors/scales and vectors, then pass valid825 against the frozen no_running baseline.
findings.title: Q8/rank3 candidate is not algorithmically admitted

findings.evidence: M163 omits coefficient generation, correction, left projection, ATLIF and fc2. The 1.6667x and 2.9441x numbers are operation/bit-count sensitivities, and no same-resource dense dynamic-BN cycle run is paired.
findings.impact: Any M163 speedup, energy, physical or system headline would be unsupported.
findings.required_fix: Build a cycle simulator with the full barrier/coefficient/correction path and a same-port, same-product-pool dense baseline; report module/subgraph scope explicitly.
findings.title: No fair measured performance baseline exists

findings.evidence: The sealed test fixes shift=9 and has no tie-even or saturation coverpoint/counter, although an independent static audit found no counterexample over the full reachable projection range and all 24 shifts.
findings.impact: The contract's edge-case coverage Boolean is not receipted by VCS evidence.
findings.required_fix: Add explicit positive/negative half ties with even/odd quotients, both saturation signs, shift 0 and shift 23, and receipt counters.
findings.title: RNE reference miter lacks explicit tie/saturation coverage

findings.evidence: Five accepted beats are structurally necessary and one consecutive five-beat cover matches, but the directed workload inserts 306 random gap cycles and does not prove sustained back-to-back multi-tile II under FIFO/barrier combinations.
findings.impact: Accepted-cycle geometry should not be promoted to full throughput or speedup.
findings.required_fix: Add a no-gap run longer than both FIFOs, assert beat-0 acceptance distance equals five without backpressure, and separately characterize stalls.
findings.title: II=5 evidence is conditional and narrow

identity.qualification: The source was independently read before replacement, but the durable review is limited to sealed launch hashes, sealed VCS outputs, the old mapped netlist, and DC reports.

moment_grain_counterexample.decision: Information is irreversibly lost; downstream logic cannot reconstruct the 16 BN1 channel moments from the scalar packet.
moment_grain_counterexample.r1_mapped_interface: one scalar 48b sum, one scalar 56b sumsq, one scalar 32b count
moment_grain_counterexample.required_moments: independent sum/sumsq/count per hidden lane over T*B*H*W

paper_safe_statement: M163 r1 instantiated the intended 96 signed-INT8 rank products, 32 square lanes and 16 shared requant lanes, and its sealed VCS passed its directed scalar reference. However, it collapsed 16 hidden-channel moments into one scalar packet, so it does not implement frozen no-running BN semantics. Its exact-SHA DC runner also rejected 0.0002 ns worst setup slack against the 0.05 ns guard. No speedup, accuracy or PPA claim is admitted.

resource_and_throughput.qualification: The arithmetic geometry is real for r1 and one no-gap five-beat tile is covered. The TB uses randomized gaps and does not establish sustained multi-tile II=5 under every FIFO/barrier condition.

vcs.reason: The scoreboard reproduces the same cross-hidden-lane scalar aggregation as the DUT.

independent_reachable_range_rne_audit.qualification: Independent static audit of the r1 function text captured before source drift; not a new exact-SHA RTL simulation.
